title: ThreatIntelligenceIOCRecord
description: Schema for normalized Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) collected for Capstone Team 221 - Issue #16

indicator.description: The Indicator of Compromise value (defanged for domains and URLs, e.g. domain[.]com or hxxp://)

source_name.description: Name of the open-source threat intelligence feed or repository

source_url.description: URL to the upstream provider or feed

source_record_id.description: Unique record or tweet identifier from the primary source, if available

first_seen.description: Timestamp when the indicator was first observed or logged by the source

last_seen.description: Timestamp when the indicator was last confirmed active, if reported

collection_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this indicator was collected into this dataset

confidence.description: Confidence level or reliability metric assigned by the provider

threat_type.description: Operational threat categorization (e.g., botnet_c2, phishing, malware_distribution, scanning_host)

malware_family.description: Identified malware family or campaign name if attributed

tags.description: Descriptive comma- or space-separated tags provided by researchers

description.description: Contextual forensic information, analyst notes, or geographical metadata
